decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (146-140-AL(5), 146-141-AL(3), 146-141-AL(6) and 146-160-AL(7) received 27 February 2012) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The basement shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwellinghouse, and shall not be used as either a self-contained dwelling or as a business premises.
Condition : 4 - Access to the basement shall only be from the rear garden.
description: Extension at basement level to provide a storage area, removal of side access from Duke Road and relocation of internal staircase (lower ground to ground)
